Engine / Source / ThirdParty

Third-party source dependencies vendored into the engine. Initial set (per Section 2 license-inventory row): Jolt Physics, Sleef, Vulkan-Headers, Vulkan-Loader, VulkanMemoryAllocator, OpenXR SDK, Recast/Detour, CPython (post-MVP), MikkTSpace, ICU, zstd, Brotli. Roslyn is referenced only and not embedded. Each dependency lives in its own subdirectory and retains its original upstream licensing headers — the Simgenics copyright header is not applied to third-party code, and XBT's pre-compile header-validation pass explicitly excludes this tree. License terms for every vendored dependency are tracked in Licenses/INVENTORY.html.
